data.name: Pyronam
data.description: PyroNam is the Namibian operating subsidiary of German biochar CDR company PyroCCS GmbH, producing biochar from FSC-certified encroaching bush biomass at an industrial plant in the Otjozondjupa region near Otjiwarongo. The company partners with atmosfair, sells EBC-certified biochar carbon removal credits, and plans to scale to 50 plants across Namibia by 2030.
